notes.title: Update 01 News
notes.content:
A quick update on things.
- We found the bug some people were having with not being able to use shift to run. That has been fixed.
- Looking into changing the run with the left joystick so you don't have to hold it down.
- Fixed other minor bugs found
- Testing the new update content and making the combat feel better.

We will be posting the update as soon as everything id ready.

notes.title: Patch 01 Compass Added
notes.content: Thanks for all the feedback, updates are coming for the game. We have added the compass for easier navigation. After you find a note, that location is added to the note. This will help the you know where you have been and give easier navigation.

notes.title: Update 01
notes.content: We are off and running with updates to the game! Our first one should be out around Black Friday featuring everyone's favorite gift giver - Santa Claus. There will be a new map to explore, new lore, new objectives and new enemies hunting you down. Thank you all for your support and more updates are on the way.
